summary: Explored and refined the minimal Flowkit core model for Delivery, Change, Action, Verification, Run scoping, deterministic recovery, the generic reviewer entry, Review Run creation timing, and stage-specific Skill boundaries. The result preserves the A1 product boundary and is ready for whole-boundary review-explore before Propose.
proposedDecisions: Change states remain planned, active, completed, cancelled.
Review, revision, verification, and checkpoint do not form an additional Phase layer.
The unique legal next Action is computed by Policy instead of stored in a current pointer.
Apply review uses review-apply and findings are corrected through fix-review-findings.
Delivery-level Runs should use the reserved _delivery directory.
Full Test remains a Delivery-level owner-authorized boundary.
Reviewer uses the generic review entry, while the formal Action remains review-explore, review-propose, or review-apply.
The review entry may execute only the unique Review Action already derived by Policy.
Discussion and ordinary commits within the same role and Action remain part of the same Run.
A reviewer Run is created when the reviewer actually begins the Review Action; the author does not pre-create an empty review Run.
A Review Action may name an execution Skill, but the Skill does not own flow decisions and the exact declaration protocol belongs to C1.
reviewFocus: Whether Delivery needs a paused state.
Whether _delivery is the correct reserved directory for Delivery-level Runs.
Whether the proposed Full Test status set is minimal.
Whether next Action can remain fully derived without a persisted current pointer.
Whether review-apply and fix-review-findings should be the canonical Apply review loop names.
Whether the generic review entry remains deterministic without a pending placeholder Run.
Whether the proposed Action and role boundary is sufficient for deciding when a new Run is created.
Whether stage-specific Skill use remains lightweight and avoids creating a Skill Router.
Whether the full B1 Explore remains inside the B1 boundary without defining C1 protocols or D1 operating steps.

verification.reason: Explore produces a decision artifact for review; no Apply verification or Full Test is applicable.
